phases.name: RAG Deep-Dive
phases.desc: Chunking → embeddings → hybrid search → reranking → evals. The single most common AI-engineer interview topic.

items.title: Chunking strategies: fixed, recursive, semantic, document-aware — tradeoffs

Hybrid search: BM25 + dense vectors, Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF)
Rerankers: cross-encoders (Cohere/bge), when the extra hop pays for itself
RAG evals: recall@k, MRR, faithfulness, answer relevance — build one eval set for a toy corpus
Jason Liu — 'Systematically improving RAG' (read twice; it is an FDE playbook in disguise)

projectStories.name: Morning TIL — multi-agent pipeline
projectStories.pitch: Every morning a LangGraph pipeline lands a fun-facts digest on my phone. A DeepSeek orchestrator plans topics and dispatches parallel workers running on a local 7B model via Ollama; workers web-search and draft TILs; DeepSeek ranks the drafts, steers rewrites, and assembles the digest. SQLite history dedupes against everything I've already learned; a fact-check pass re-searches every claim. Cost is near-zero because the high-token grunt work is local — the frontier model only plans and judges.
